evidence_source: Existing tool execution session 23653, final chunk 2905e3; recorded without rerunning tests

tests.name: test_bundle_tampering_and_overwrite_fail_before_restore
tests.scope: Published disposable bundle cannot be overwritten; tampered snapshot digest is rejected before controller state changes.

tests.name: test_c_executes_all_original_40_t_then_r_without_schedule_shortening
tests.scope: Actual tiny H0 performs all 40 T updates and four logical R updates, retaining phase 5 then phase 6 and the unshortened plan. T/R disk replay both pass; 44 original-style logical update rows are retained.

tests.name: test_gpu_identity_rejects_mig_small_memory_and_unverified_uuid
tests.scope: Mocked device properties and nvidia-smi text validate UUID correlation and reject insufficient memory, MIG UUID and unknown UUID. This is not a real H100 or nvidia-smi check.

tests.name: test_invalid_budget_is_rejected_before_supervisor_or_gpu
tests.scope: Invalid, nonfinite and over-limit durations fail argument parsing without dispatching the worker.

tests.name: test_real_abc_next_update_disk_restore_exact_and_published_bundle_rejected
tests.scope: Real tiny A/B R and C T updates preserve inactive state and counters. Disk restore reproduces full next-update state and values; reusable optimizer snapshots are not aliased. Each R decoder layer has active gradients/updates. Outer preflight bundles are rejected even with allow_preflight=True.

tests.name: test_real_fp32_batch32_decode_preserves_training_rng_gradients_and_modes
tests.scope: Real toy catalog and FP32 beam32/batch32 generation run twice; complete lists are valid and equal. Full training state, RNG, modes and gradients are unchanged. Only dataset release lookup and its source SHA are mocked.

tests.name: test_supervisor_terminates_hanging_cpu_worker_before_deadline
tests.scope: A real disposable sleeping CPU subprocess is terminated by the deadline supervisor; no training or GPU worker is used.

limits: Tests use nine-item synthetic assets and tiny model dimensions; production KuaiRec and fixed parent checkpoints are not trained by this suite.
CPU BF16 update checks do not establish CUDA kernel determinism, H100 memory fit, real GPU identity or production throughput.
The exact next-update comparisons concern saved and restored state within the tested tiny CPU execution; they do not claim bitwise recovery of the unavailable historical H0 R20 checkpoint.
The complete imported runtime was not separately snapshotted by this test command. These results must not be attributed to later source modifications without checking the final package.
Formal H100 acceptance, source/data bindings and the cumulative 0.5 GPU-hour budget remain separately required.
